findings.plain: The parent's screens and the helper's review screen still use made-up sample data and never talk to the real app, so a message Galina pastes is not saved, Alex gets no email, Alex's tap on Scam or All good is not recorded, and his answer never reaches Galina's phone.

Helpers still cannot really sign up, set up the second sign-in step, add their parent or sign the parent in for 90 days, because those steps only move between example screens and no account is ever created.
The Claude AI is still never asked about any message, so every check gets only the simple keyword rules and is always marked rules-only, even when the AI is working.
Galina's result screen still has example links such as "Alex says All good" that show her an "All good" answer Alex never gave, plus a preview banner on the screen.
None of the ten approved scenarios has a real test yet, so nothing proves the app does what was approved.
